phrases.example: There are a lot of people here.
I'm a little bit tired.
She has a great deal of experience.
I have a few questions.
I saw him a while ago.

translations.translation: 离弃，丢弃；遗弃，抛弃；放弃

phrases.example: They abandoned the plan due to lack of funding.
phrases.example_translation: 由于缺乏资金，他们放弃了计划。

phrases.example: Never abandon hope, even in difficult times.
phrases.example_translation: 即使在困难时期也永远不要放弃希望。

phrases.example: The captain ordered everyone to abandon the ship.
She abandoned herself to grief.
The children played with abandon.

translations.translation: 能力， 本领； 才能， 才智

phrases.example: She has the ability to solve complex problems.
phrases.example_translation: 她有解决复杂问题的能力。

phrases.example: He has a natural ability for music.
Students are grouped by ability level.
Do you have the ability to work under pressure?
phrases.example_translation: 你有在压力下工作的能力吗？

phrases.example: The task was beyond his ability.
phrases.example_translation: 这项任务超出了他的能力。

phrases.example: She will be able to finish the work on time.
phrases.example_translation: 她将能够按时完成工作。

phrases.example: I'm not able to help right now.
She is an able student with great potential.
phrases.example_translation: 她是一个有能力的学生，潜力很大。

phrases.example: I'll come as soon as I'm able.
She is able and willing to take on the task.
phrases.example_translation: 她有能力且愿意承担这项任务。

phrases.example: The doctor noticed abnormal behavior in the patient.
phrases.example_translation: 医生注意到患者的异常行为。

phrases.example: The test showed an abnormal result.
The machine was operating under abnormal conditions.
phrases.example_translation: 机器在异常条件下运行。

phrases.example: The scan revealed abnormal growth in the tissue.
phrases.example_translation: 扫描显示组织中有异常生长。

phrases.example: The situation was abnormal and unusual.
Passengers went aboard the plane.
Welcome aboard the team!
There were 200 passengers aboard the train.
The children climbed aboard the bus.
All aboard — the train is about to leave!
phrases.example_translation: 全体登船——火车就要开了！

phrases.example: Let's talk about the plan.
I need to think about your offer.
Do you know about the meeting?
Tell me all about your trip.
How about going for a walk?
Above all, be honest with yourself.
phrases.example_translation: 最重要的是，对自己诚实。

phrases.example: Her performance was above average.
phrases.example_translation: 她的表现高于平均水平。

phrases.example: No one is above the law.
phrases.example_translation: 没有人能凌驾于法律之上。

phrases.example: The above mentioned points are important.
She went above and beyond what was expected.

translations.translation: 到国外； 在传播， 在流传

phrases.example: She decided to go abroad for further study.
He studied abroad for two years.
Many people travel abroad every year.
The brand is popular at home and abroad.
phrases.example_translation: 这个品牌在国内外都很受欢迎。

phrases.example: She came back from abroad last month.
phrases.example_translation: 她上个月从国外回来了。

phrases.example: The car stopped abruptly at the red light.
phrases.example_translation: 汽车在红灯前突然停了下来。

phrases.example: The music ended abruptly when the power went out.
He spoke abruptly and left the room.
phrases.example_translation: 他说话很冲，然后离开了房间。

phrases.example: The weather changed abruptly in the afternoon.
Prices rose abruptly after the holiday.

translations.translation: 缺席， 不在； 缺席的时间， 外出期； 缺乏， 不存在

phrases.example: In the absence of evidence, the case was dropped.
phrases.example_translation: 在缺乏证据的情况下，案件被撤销了。

phrases.example: His absence from work lasted two weeks.
Her absence of mind caused several errors.
phrases.example_translation: 她的心不在焉导致了几个错误。

phrases.example: In his absence, she took charge.
After a long absence, he returned home.
phrases.example_translation: 长期缺席后，他回到了家。

translations.translation: 缺席的， 不在场的； 缺乏的， 不存在的； 心不在焉的

phrases.example: He was absent from school yesterday.
She is very absent minded.
He was absent without leave.
He has been long absent from work.
She had an absent expression on her face.

translations.translation: 十足的， 地道的； 绝对的， 完全的； 不受任何限制的

phrases.example: Absolute power corrupts absolutely.
phrases.example_translation: 绝对权力导致绝对腐败。

phrases.example: There is no absolute truth in this matter.
The party won an absolute majority in the election.
phrases.example_translation: 该党在选举中赢得了绝对多数。

phrases.example: The room was in absolute silence.
The course is designed for absolute beginners.
phrases.example_translation: 该课程专为完全初学者设计。

phrases.example: You are absolutely right about that.
It is absolutely necessary to follow the rules.
phrases.example_translation: 遵守规则是绝对必要的。

phrases.example: I'm not absolutely sure about the answer.
phrases.example_translation: 我对答案不是完全确定。

phrases.example: She absolutely loves chocolate.
That is absolutely not acceptable.

translations.translation: 吸收； 吸引…的注意， 使全神贯注； 把…并入， 同化

phrases.example: The sponge absorbed all the spilled water.
phrases.example_translation: 海绵吸收了所有洒出的水。

phrases.example: Children absorb knowledge quickly.
She was absorbed in her book.
phrases.example_translation: 她全神贯注地看她的书。

phrases.example: The material absorbs shock well.
phrases.example_translation: 这种材料能很好地吸收冲击。

phrases.example: The company will absorb the extra cost.

translations.translation: 摘要， 梗概； 抽象派艺术作品

phrases.example: She specializes in abstract art.
Justice is an abstract concept.
Children develop abstract thinking over time.
phrases.example_translation: 儿童随时间发展抽象思维。

phrases.example: Love is an abstract noun.
The lecture discussed abstract ideas.

translations.translation: 丰富的， 富裕的； 大量的， 充足的

phrases.example: The region has abundant natural resources.
phrases.example_translation: 该地区拥有丰富的自然资源。

phrases.example: There is abundant evidence to support the theory.
phrases.example_translation: 有充分的证据支持该理论。

phrases.example: The country has an abundant supply of food.
phrases.example_translation: 该国有充足的食物供应。

phrases.example: The area is abundant in wildlife.
phrases.example_translation: 该地区有丰富的野生动物。

phrases.example: The city offers abundant opportunities for employment.
phrases.example_translation: 这座城市提供了大量的就业机会。

translations.translation: 滥用； 虐待， 伤害； 辱骂， 毁谤
滥用； 虐待， 伤害； 辱骂， 毁谤

phrases.example: He was fired for abusing his power.
phrases.example_translation: 他因滥用权力而被解雇。

phrases.example: Some athletes abuse drugs to win.
phrases.example_translation: 一些运动员滥用药物以求获胜。

phrases.example: Child abuse is a serious crime.
phrases.example_translation: 虐待儿童是严重的罪行。

phrases.example: She suffered verbal abuse at work.
phrases.example_translation: 她在工作中遭受言语辱骂。

phrases.example: He abused our trust by lying.
phrases.example_translation: 他撒谎，辜负了我们的信任。

translations.translation: 学院的； 学术的； 纯理论的， 不切实际的

phrases.example: His academic performance improved this year.
phrases.example_translation: 他今年的学业成绩有所提高。

phrases.example: The academic year starts in September.
This theory is debated in academic circles.
phrases.example_translation: 这一理论在学术界存在争议。

phrases.example: She earned an academic degree in law.
He is engaged in academic research.

translations.translation: 研究会， 学会； 专门学校

phrases.example: He was elected to the science academy.
She graduated from the military academy.
The film won several academy awards.
phrases.example_translation: 这部电影获得了多项学院奖。

phrases.example: She studied at the academy of arts.
The academy of sciences published the report.
Technology can accelerate the learning process.
phrases.example_translation: 技术可以加速学习进程。

phrases.example: The company aims to accelerate its growth.
Investment will accelerate development in the region.
phrases.example_translation: 投资将加速该地区的发展。

phrases.example: The car rapidly accelerated on the highway.
phrases.example_translation: 汽车在高速公路上迅速加速。

phrases.example: Policies aim to accelerate the transition to clean energy.
phrases.example_translation: 政策旨在加速向清洁能源过渡。

phrases.example: The rate of acceleration was impressive.
The acceleration of economic growth was notable.
phrases.example_translation: 经济增长的加速引人注目。

phrases.example: The project entered the acceleration phase.
The object moved with constant acceleration.
phrases.example_translation: 物体以恒定加速度运动。

phrases.example: The sudden acceleration caused the accident.

translations.translation: 口音， 腔调； 重音

phrases.example: He speaks English with a strong accent.
phrases.example_translation: 他说英语带着浓重的口音。

phrases.example: She has a regional accent from the south.
The word has an accent mark on the last syllable.
phrases.example_translation: 这个词在最后一个音节上有重音符号。

phrases.example: The course puts accent on practical skills.
Her accent of French is charming.
She accepted the job offer.
He finally accepted the truth.
You must accept responsibility for your actions.
phrases.example_translation: 你必须为自己的行为承担责任。

phrases.example: She learned to accept the situation.
The theory is widely accepted.
The work must meet an acceptable standard.
phrases.example_translation: 工作必须达到可接受的标准。

phrases.usage: 表示「对某人来说可接受」」
phrases.example: The terms are acceptable to both parties.
phrases.example_translation: 这些条款对双方都可接受。

phrases.example: That kind of behavior is not acceptable.
The noise was within an acceptable level.
phrases.example_translation: 噪音在可接受的水平内。

phrases.example: The practice is socially acceptable.
phrases.example_translation: 这种做法在社会上是可以接受的。

translations.translation: 接受； 承认； 容忍

phrases.example: The acceptance of the proposal was unanimous.
phrases.example_translation: 对该提案的接受是一致通过的。

phrases.example: She received a letter of acceptance from the university.
phrases.example_translation: 她收到了大学的录取通知书。

phrases.example: Social acceptance of the idea grew over time.
phrases.example_translation: 社会对这个想法的认可随时间增长。

phrases.example: She gave a moving acceptance speech.
phrases.example_translation: 她发表了感人的获奖感言。

phrases.example: He nodded in acceptance of the terms.

translations.translation: 接近；通道，入口；接近的机会

phrases.example: Students have access to the library.
They gained access to the building.
The hotel has easy access to the beach.
phrases.example_translation: 这家酒店去海滩很方便。

phrases.example: The system denied his access.
The park is for public access.
He was charged as an accessary to the crime.
She was an accessary before the fact.
He was accused of being an accessary after the fact.
The law distinguishes between principal and accessary.
He was found guilty as an accessary to murder.
phrases.example_translation: 他被判犯有谋杀从犯罪。

phrases.example: The file is easily accessible online.
phrases.example_translation: 这个文件在网上很容易获取。

phrases.example: The museum is accessible to wheelchair users.
phrases.example_translation: 博物馆对轮椅使用者无障碍。

phrases.example: They made the website accessible to all.
phrases.example_translation: 他们让网站对所有人可用。

phrases.example: The school is in an accessible location.
phrases.example_translation: 学校位于交通便利之处。

phrases.example: Information is readily accessible today.

phrases.example_translation: 十字路口发生了交通事故。

phrases.example: I found the book by accident.
He was taken to accident and emergency.

phrases.example_translation: 工业事故导致五名工人受伤。

phrases.example: She has accident insurance.

phrases.example_translation: 青霉素是一个偶然发现。

phrases.example: The insurance covers accidental damage.
It was an accidental error, not intentional.
phrases.example_translation: 那是一个偶然错误，不是故意的。

phrases.example: Accidental exposure to the chemical is dangerous.
phrases.example_translation: 意外暴露于该化学物质是危险的。

phrases.example: The hotel can accommodate 200 guests.
phrases.example_translation: 这家酒店可容纳200位客人。

phrases.example: We will accommodate your special needs.
phrases.example_translation: 我们会满足您的特殊需求。

phrases.example: The plan must accommodate changes.

The school provides accommodation for students.

phrases.example_translation: 我们需要找今晚的住处。

phrases.example: Student accommodation is available on campus.

phrases.example_translation: 他们被安置在临时住所。

phrases.example: We booked accommodation online.
phrases.example_translation: 我们在网上预订了住宿。

translations.translation: 陪伴， 陪同， 伴随； 为…伴奏

phrases.example_translation: 葡萄酒很好地搭配餐食。

phrases.example: We accomplished our goal ahead of time.
He accomplished the task with ease.
They accomplished nothing all day.
The team accomplished its mission.
The project was hard to accomplish.

translations.translation: 使符合；使一致；调节；授予，赠与，给予

phrases.example: The decision was in accord with the policy.
She left of her own accord.

The government accorded him special treatment.
The two sides reached an accord.
The work was done in accordance with the rules.
The case was handled in accordance with the law.
Everything went in accordance with the plan.
The decision was made in accordance with policy.
The funeral was held in accordance with her wishes.
phrases.example_translation: 葬礼按照她的意愿举行。

translations.translation: 相等的， 一致的， 依…而定的

phrases.example_translation: 根据报告，销售额增长了20%。

phrases.example: The price varies according as the season changes.
phrases.example_translation: 价格随季节变化而不同。

phrases.example: Everything went off according to plan.
phrases.example_translation: 一切都按计划顺利进行。

phrases.example: You must play according to the rules.

phrases.example_translation: 我们将视情况决定做什么。

translations.translation: 因此， 所以； 照着

phrases.example: Read the instructions and act accordingly.
phrases.example_translation: 阅读说明并相应地行动。

phrases.example: Check the weather and plan accordingly.
phrases.example_translation: 查看天气并相应地计划。

phrases.example: Prices may change — adjust accordingly.
phrases.example_translation: 价格可能会变——相应调整。

phrases.example: Prepare accordingly for the exam.
We will decide accordingly based on the results.
phrases.example_translation: 我们将根据结果相应决定。

phrases.example: She opened a bank account last week.
phrases.example_translation: 她上周开了一个银行账户。

phrases.example: The event was canceled on account of rain.
phrases.example_translation: 活动由于下雨被取消了。

phrases.example: We must take all factors into account.
phrases.example_translation: 我们必须考虑到所有因素。

phrases.example: Exports account for 40% of the economy.
By all accounts, the event was a success.
phrases.example_translation: 据各方面所说，活动很成功。

phrases.example: She decided to study accountancy at university.
phrases.example_translation: 她决定在大学学习会计学。

phrases.example: He works for a leading accountancy firm in London.
phrases.example_translation: 他在伦敦一家领先的会计事务所工作。

phrases.example: Professional accountancy requires attention to detail.
phrases.example_translation: 专业会计工作需要注重细节。

phrases.example: I enrolled in an accountancy course last semester.
phrases.example_translation: 上学期我报名参加了一门会计课程。

phrases.example: She obtained her accountancy qualification after three years of study.
phrases.example_translation: 经过三年的学习，她获得了会计资格证书。

phrases.example: You should consult a certified accountant for tax advice.
phrases.example_translation: 你应该咨询注册会计师获取税务建议。

phrases.example: She has been working as an accountant for ten years.
phrases.example_translation: 她担任会计已经十年了。

phrases.example: The company decided to hire a new accountant.
phrases.example_translation: 公司决定雇用一名新会计。

phrases.usage: 表示「会计主管，总会计师」
phrases.example: The accountant general presented the annual budget.
phrases.example_translation: 总会计师提交了年度预算。

phrases.example: He was promoted to senior accountant last year.
phrases.example_translation: 他去年被提升为高级会计师。

phrases.example: He accumulated great wealth over years.
phrases.example_translation: 他多年来积累了巨额财富。

phrases.example: She accumulated experience in teaching.
The company accumulated heavy debt.
phrases.example_translation: 公司累积了沉重的债务。

phrases.example: Dust accumulates over time.
Police accumulated evidence against him.
phrases.example_translation: 警方收集了针对他的证据。

phrases.example: The accuracy of the data is crucial.
phrases.example_translation: 数据的准确性至关重要。

phrases.example: The instrument has high accuracy.
The accuracy rate of the test is 95%.
She answered the questions with accuracy.
Training helps improve accuracy.
phrases.example_translation: 训练有助于提高准确性。

translations.translation: 准确的， 正确无误的

phrases.example: We need accurate information.
The report is accurate in its figures.
phrases.example_translation: 报告的 figures 是准确的。

phrases.example: He gave an accurate description of the suspect.
phrases.example_translation: 他对嫌疑人作了准确的描述。
科学家做出了准确的预测。
phrases.example: The scientist made an accurate prediction.
Your answer is perfectly accurate.
The minister had to face serious accusations of corruption.
phrases.example_translation: 部长不得不面临严重的腐败指控。

phrases.example: He sued the newspaper for making false accusations against his character.
phrases.example_translation: 他起诉报纸对他的品格进行虚假指控。

phrases.example: The suspect firmly denied the accusation during the interrogation.
phrases.example_translation: 嫌疑人在审讯中坚决否认了指控。

phrases.example: The opposition party levelled an accusation of bribery at the minister.
phrases.example_translation: 反对党对部长提出了贿赂指控。

phrases.example: The prosecution decided to withdraw the accusation due to lack of evidence.
phrases.example_translation: 由于缺乏证据，控方决定撤回指控。

phrases.example: He was accused of stealing.
She was falsely accused of the crime.
He accused her of lying to him.
They were accused of breaking the law.
Citizens accused the government of corruption.
She accustomed herself to the cold weather.
phrases.example_translation: 她使自己习惯了寒冷的天气。

phrases.example: He is accustomed to working long hours.
The teacher accustomed the students to daily tests.
phrases.example_translation: 老师让学生习惯了每天考试。

phrases.example: It took time to accustom to the new environment.
phrases.example_translation: 适应新环境花了些时间。

phrases.example: She followed her accustomed way of doing things.
phrases.example_translation: 她按照自己习惯的方式做事。

phrases.example: She is accustomed to early mornings.
He sat in his accustomed place.
She followed her accustomed routine.
phrases.example_translation: 她遵循惯常的例行公事。

phrases.example: He gave his accustomed response.
She became accustomed to the noise.
After the exercise, she ached all over.
I have a terrible headache.
She ached for her family back home.
He has a stomach ache after eating too much.
Sitting too long causes back ache.
Hard work helps you achieve success.
phrases.example_translation: 努力工作助你取得成功。

phrases.example: She achieved her goal at last.
He achieved fame as a writer.
phrases.example_translation: 他作为作家获得了名声。

phrases.example: Without effort you achieve nothing.
The policy achieved good results.
phrases.example_translation: 该政策取得了良好成果。

translations.translation: 完成； 成就， 成绩

phrases.example: Winning the Nobel Prize is a great achievement.
phrases.example_translation: 赢得诺贝尔奖是一项伟大成就。

phrases.example: She has outstanding academic achievement.
Completing the project gave her a sense of achievement.
phrases.example_translation: 完成项目给了她成就感。

phrases.example: He made remarkable achievements in science.
phrases.example_translation: 他在科学方面取得了显著成就。

phrases.example: Running the marathon was a personal achievement.
phrases.example_translation: 跑马拉松是一项个人成就。

phrases.example: Acid rain damages forests and lakes.
Omega-3 is a healthy fatty acid.
The exam was an acid test of their knowledge.
phrases.example_translation: 考试是对他们知识的严峻考验。

phrases.example: Sulfuric acid is used in many industries.
phrases.example_translation: 硫酸在许多工业中使用。

phrases.example: The fruit had an acid and bitter taste.

translations.translation: 承认， 承认…的权威； 告知收到， 确认； 对…表示感谢， 报偿

phrases.example: He acknowledged his mistake publicly.
Please acknowledge receipt of this email.
She acknowledged his help in her speech.
phrases.example_translation: 她在演讲中感谢了他的帮助。

phrases.example: They refused to acknowledge his authority.
phrases.example_translation: 他们拒绝承认他的权威。

phrases.example: It is widely acknowledged that exercise is healthy.
phrases.example_translation: 人们广泛承认运动有益健康。

phrases.example: You should acquaint yourself with the new software.
phrases.example_translation: 你应该使自己熟悉新软件。

phrases.example: Let me acquaint you with the facts of the case.
phrases.example_translation: 让我让你了解这个案件的事实。

phrases.example: I am already acquainted with the procedure.

phrases.example_translation: 新政策包含对小型企业的税收优惠。

translations.translation: 推断出， 推论出； 结束， 终了； 缔结， 议定

phrases.example: We concluded that the plan was not feasible.
phrases.example_translation: 我们得出结论，该计划不可行。

phrases.example: The chairman concluded the meeting.
They concluded a business deal.
phrases.example_translation: 他们达成了一笔商业交易。

phrases.example: She concluded with a song.
To conclude, I support this proposal.

translations.translation: 结论， 推论； 结尾； 缔结， 议定

phrases.example: We drew a conclusion from the data.
phrases.example_translation: 我们从数据得出了结论。

phrases.example: In conclusion, I agree with you.
They reached a conclusion.
Don't jump to conclusions.
The final conclusion was clear.
Can you give a concrete example?
phrases.example_translation: 你能给一个具体的例子吗？

phrases.example: There is no concrete evidence to support the claim.
phrases.example_translation: 没有确凿的证据支持这一说法。

phrases.example: We need a concrete plan before proceeding.
phrases.example_translation: 在继续之前我们需要一个具体的计划。

phrases.example: The project has produced concrete results.
phrases.example_translation: 该项目产生了具体的成果。

phrases.example: Workers poured concrete for the foundation.
phrases.example_translation: 工人为地基浇筑了混凝土。

translations.translation: 谴责， 指责； 判…刑， 宣告…有罪

phrases.example: The government condemned the violent act.
He was condemned to death.
The old building was condemned.
phrases.example_translation: 这座旧建筑被判定为危房。

phrases.example: He was condemned for his actions.
phrases.example_translation: 他因自己的行为被谴责。

phrases.example: The attack was universally condemned.
phrases.example_translation: 这次攻击受到普遍谴责。

translations.translation: 冷凝， 凝结； 浓缩， 压缩， 简缩

phrases.example: The report was condensed into one page.
She condensed the text to 500 words.
Steam condenses into water when cooled.
He condensed the key points into a summary.
She added condensed milk to the coffee.

translations.translation: 状况， 状态； 环境

phrases.example: The car is in good condition.
I'll agree on condition that you pay.
Living conditions have improved.
Under the current condition, we must adapt.
phrases.example_translation: 在当前条件下，我们必须适应。

phrases.example: She set strict conditions for the deal.
phrases.example_translation: 她为交易设定了严格的条件。

translations.translation: 举止， 行为； 指导； 管理； 实施
进行； 管理， 指挥， 引导； 传输， 传导

phrases.example: They conducted a survey of public opinion.
She conducted herself well in the meeting.
phrases.example_translation: 她在会议上表现得很好。

phrases.example: Scientists conducted an experiment.
He was rewarded for good conduct.
phrases.example_translation: 他因良好行为受到奖励。

phrases.example: Copper conducts electricity well.

translations.translation: 售票员， 列车长； 指挥； 导体

phrases.example: The bus conductor collected the fares.
phrases.example_translation: 公交车售票员收了车费。

phrases.example: The orchestra conductor raised his baton.
phrases.example_translation: 乐队指挥举起了指挥棒。

phrases.example: The train conductor checked our tickets.
phrases.example_translation: 列车长检查了我们的票。

phrases.example: The building has a lightning conductor.
Metal is a good heat conductor.

translations.translation: 会议， 讨论会； 讨论， 商谈

phrases.example: They held a conference in London.
phrases.example_translation: 他们在伦敦召开了会议。

phrases.example: The minister held a press conference.
phrases.example_translation: 部长举行了新闻发布会。

phrases.example: The meeting is in the conference room.
She attended an international conference.
phrases.example_translation: 她参加了一次国际会议。

phrases.example: We had a conference call this morning.
phrases.example_translation: 我们今天早上开了电话会议。

translations.translation: 供认， 坦白； 承认

phrases.example: He confessed to the crime.
She confessed that she was wrong.
The suspect confessed his guilt.
He confessed his love to her.
She confessed openly about her past.
phrases.example_translation: 她公开坦白了自己的过去。

translations.translation: 信任， 信赖； 信心， 自信

phrases.example: The course builds your confidence.
He lacks confidence in public.
phrases.example_translation: 他在公众面前缺乏信心。

phrases.example: She spoke with confidence.
We have confidence in the team.
Winning boosted his confidence.

translations.translation: 确信的， 肯定的； 自信的

phrases.example: She is confident about the exam.
He gave a confident smile.
She is a confident public speaker.
phrases.example_translation: 她是自信的公开演讲者。

phrases.example: I feel confident about the result.
She made a confident decision.
phrases.example_translation: 她做了一个自信的决定。

translations.translation: 秘密的， 机密的； 亲信的

phrases.example: You must not disclose confidential information to outsiders.
phrases.example_translation: 你不得向外部人员泄露机密信息。

phrases.example: This document is strictly confidential.
The journalist refused to reveal her confidential source.
phrases.example_translation: 记者拒绝透露她的机密消息来源。

phrases.example: The confidential report was leaked to the press.
phrases.example_translation: 机密报告被泄露给了媒体。

phrases.example: Please keep this matter confidential until further notice.
phrases.example_translation: 在另行通知之前，请对此事保密。

translations.translation: 限制， 使局限； 使不外出， 禁闭

phrases.example: Please confine your remarks to the topic.
phrases.example_translation: 请将你的发言局限在话题内。

phrases.example: He confined himself to two questions.
phrases.example_translation: 他将自己限于两个问题。

phrases.example: She was confined to bed for a week.
The animals were confined within the fence.
His imagination is beyond confine.

translations.translation: 证实， 肯定； 确认； 批准

phrases.example: Please confirm your booking.
Confirm receipt of the package.
They confirmed the plan.
The test confirmed our suspicion.
phrases.example_translation: 检测证实了我们的怀疑。

phrases.example: The news was confirmed by the police.

translations.translation: 冲突， 抵触， 争论； 战斗， 战争

phrases.example: The two sides are in conflict.
His plan conflicts with mine.
The armed conflict ended.
He declared a conflict of interest.
They tried to resolve the conflict.
Cars must conform to safety rules.
phrases.example_translation: 汽车必须符合安全规则。

phrases.example: His actions conform with the law.
The product failed to conform.
It conforms to the standard.
He refused to socially conform.

translations.translation: 迎面遇到， 遭遇； 勇敢地面对， 正视； 使对质， 使当面对证

phrases.example: We must confront the problem.
phrases.example_translation: 我们必须面对这个问题。

phrases.example: She confronted her boss.
He was confronted with the truth.
She confronted the challenge bravely.
He learned to confront his fear.
The armed confrontation lasted for hours.
phrases.example_translation: 武装对抗持续了数小时。

phrases.example: He tried to avoid confrontation with his boss.
phrases.example_translation: 他试图避免与老板对抗。

phrases.example: The confrontation between the two nations escalated.
phrases.example_translation: 两国之间的对抗升级了。

phrases.example: A direct confrontation with the enemy was unavoidable.
phrases.example_translation: 与敌人的直接对抗不可避免。

phrases.example: They had a verbal confrontation in the office.
phrases.example_translation: 他们在办公室发生了言语冲突。

translations.translation: 使困惑， 把…弄糊涂； 混淆， 把…混同； 混乱， 搞乱

phrases.example: People often confuse the two words.
phrases.example_translation: 人们经常把这两个词混淆。

phrases.example: Do not confuse the issue with irrelevant details.
phrases.example_translation: 不要用无关细节使问题复杂化。

phrases.example: The instructions confused everyone about the rules.
phrases.example_translation: 说明让每个人对规则感到困惑。

phrases.example: He confused right and wrong.
It was a confusing situation.
phrases.example_translation: 那是一个令人困惑的局面。

translations.translation: 困惑， 糊涂； 混淆； 骚乱

phrases.example: She looked at him in confusion.
The change caused confusion.
There is confusion about the new rules.
Label everything to avoid confusion.
phrases.example_translation: 给所有东西贴标签以避免混淆。

phrases.example: He suffered from mental confusion.
I congratulated her on her success.
She congratulated herself on the decision.
phrases.example_translation: 她庆幸自己做了那个决定。

phrases.example: They congratulated him warmly.
The mayor congratulated the winner.
They congratulated each other on the achievement.
phrases.example_translation: 他们互相祝贺了这个成就。

translations.translation: 贺词； 祝贺， 恭喜

phrases.example: She offered her congratulations to the couple.
phrases.example_translation: 她向这对夫妇表示了祝贺。

phrases.example: Congratulations on your promotion!
Warm congratulations on your wedding.
She received a letter of congratulation.
He gave a speech of congratulation.

translations.translation: 代表大会； [C-]国会， 议会

phrases.example: Congress voted to pass the bill.
phrases.example_translation: 国会投票通过了该法案。

phrases.example: He is a member of congress.
The congress session lasted three days.
The national congress was held in Beijing.
phrases.example_translation: 全国代表大会在北京举行。

phrases.example: The congress building is a landmark.

translations.translation: 接合， 连接， 联合； 连词

phrases.example: The event was held in conjunction with the festival.
'And' is a common conjunction.
The conjunction of events was surprising.
'In spite of' is a conjunction phrase.
The two drugs work best in conjunction.
phrases.example_translation: 两种药物联合使用效果最好。

translations.translation: 连接， 结合， 联系； 给…接通电话

phrases.example: Connect the printer to the computer.
She connected with her old friends online.
phrases.example_translation: 她在网上与老朋友联系。

phrases.usage: 表示「连点成线；理清头绪」
phrases.example: Can you connect the dots for me?
He is well-connected in the industry.
phrases.example_translation: 他在这个行业人脉很广。

phrases.usage: 表示「将两件事联系起来」
phrases.example: I can't connect the two events.
phrases.example_translation: 我无法将两件事联系起来。

translations.translation: 联系， 关系； 连接， 衔接； 连贯性； 熟人， 关系

phrases.example: I'm writing in connection with your advertisement.
phrases.example_translation: 我写信是关于你们的广告。

phrases.example: She made a connection between the two cases.
phrases.example_translation: 她在两个案例之间建立了联系。

phrases.example: The internet connection is slow.
Is there a connection between diet and health?
phrases.example_translation: 饮食和健康之间有联系吗？

phrases.example: The loose connection caused the problem.
phrases.example_translation: 松散的连接导致了问题。

phrases.example: The laptop has wireless connectivity.
The area has poor connectivity.
The new tower improves connectivity.
Check your internet connectivity.
Technology enables global connectivity.
The police questioned him in connexion with the robbery that occurred last week.
phrases.example_translation: 警察就上周发生的抢劫案对他进行了询问。

phrases.example: It took me a while to make a connexion between the two events.
phrases.example_translation: 我花了一段时间才把两件事联系起来。

phrases.example: There is a direct connexion between smoking and lung cancer.
phrases.example_translation: 吸烟与肺癌之间有直接联系。

phrases.example: I lost my internet connexion during the important video conference.
phrases.example_translation: 我在重要的视频会议中失去了网络连接。

phrases.example: Researchers are studying the connexion between diet and mental health.
phrases.example_translation: 研究人员正在研究饮食与心理健康之间的联系。

translations.translation: 征服， 战胜； 破除， 克服

phrases.example: The army conquered the country.
She conquered her fear of heights.
phrases.example_translation: 她克服了对高度的恐惧。

phrases.example: He conquered every challenge.
The empire conquered the known world.
phrases.example_translation: 帝国征服了已知的世界。

phrases.example: She conquered many difficulties.

translations.translation: 攻取， 征服， 克服

phrases.example: The conquest of space began in the 20th century.
The military conquest took years.
Self-conquest is the greatest victory.
phrases.example_translation: 自我克制是最大的胜利。

phrases.example: The conquest of nature is not easy.
The Norman conquest changed England.
phrases.example_translation: 诺曼征服改变了英格兰。

phrases.example: He had a guilty conscience.
I can face you with a clear conscience.
phrases.example_translation: 我可以问心无愧地面对你。

phrases.example: His conscience told him to stop.
phrases.example_translation: 他的良心告诉他该停下来。

phrases.example: For her it was a matter of conscience.
phrases.example_translation: 对她而言这是良心问题。

phrases.example: The letter appealed to his conscience.
phrases.example_translation: 那封信唤起了他的良知。

translations.translation: 意识到的， 自觉的； 神志清醒的； 有意的， 存心的

phrases.example: She was conscious of being watched.
It was a conscious decision.
phrases.example_translation: 这是一个有意识的决定。

phrases.example: She made a conscious effort to improve.
He remained conscious after the accident.
The thought was in her conscious mind.
phrases.example_translation: 这个想法在她的意识中。

phrases.example: He lost consciousness after the accident.
She regained consciousness in the hospital.
He has a strong sense of self consciousness.
There is a growing consciousness of environmental issues.
phrases.example_translation: 对环境问题的意识日益增长。

phrases.example: The novel uses stream of consciousness technique.
phrases.example_translation: 这部小说使用意识流技巧。

phrases.example: The group reached a consensus.
There is a general consensus.
Consensus among experts is rare.
phrases.example_translation: 专家之间达成共识很少见。

phrases.example: The talks built consensus.
The consensus view was optimistic.
He gave his consent to the plan.
She consented to the surgery.
They used it without consent.
phrases.example_translation: 他们未经同意就使用了它。

phrases.example: The contract ended by mutual consent.
Please sign the consent form.

translations.translation: 结果， 后果； 重要， 重大

phrases.example: As a consequence, he was late.
You must face the consequences.
The mistake had serious consequences.
The consequence of war is suffering.
It was a direct consequence.

translations.translation: 因此， 因而， 所以

phrases.example: He missed the train and consequently was late.
phrases.example_translation: 他错过了火车因此迟到了。

phrases.example: The error consequently led to failure.
phrases.example_translation: 该错误从而导致了失败。

phrases.example: The drought consequently affected crop yields.
phrases.example_translation: 干旱进而影响了作物产量。

phrases.example: Prices rose and consequently reduced demand.
phrases.example_translation: 价格上涨因此减少了需求。

phrases.example: She studied hard and consequently improved her grades.
phrases.example_translation: 她努力学习因此提高了成绩。

translations.translation: 保存； 保护； 守恒

phrases.example: Wildlife conservation is a global priority.
phrases.example_translation: 野生动物保护是全球优先事项。

phrases.example: Energy conservation reduces costs.
Conservation of water is essential.
phrases.example_translation: 水资源的保护至关重要。

phrases.example: The forest is a designated conservation area.
phrases.example_translation: 这片森林是指定的保护区。

phrases.example: Conservation efforts have saved many species.
phrases.example_translation: 保护工作拯救了许多物种。

translations.translation: 保守的，守旧的；不时兴的，传统的

phrases.example: He holds a conservative view.
A conservative estimate is 100.
He voted for the conservative party.
She wore conservative dress.
They took a conservative approach.
phrases.example_translation: 他们采取了稳妥的做法。

phrases.example: She considered moving abroad.
He is considered as an expert.
Please consider the matter carefully.
We must take all factors into consideration.
phrases.example_translation: 我们必须考虑所有因素。

phrases.example: I consider that he is right.
He saved a considerable amount.
She has considerable influence.
It took considerable time.
The city saw considerable change.
The task needs considerable effort.
phrases.example_translation: 这项任务需要相当大的努力。

phrases.example: Prices increased considerably.
The two plans differ considerably.
Her health improved considerably.
It costs considerably less.
He earns considerably more.

translations.translation: 考虑周到的， 体贴的， 体谅的

phrases.example: She is a considerate person.
Be considerate of others.
It was a considerate act.
He is considerate toward the elderly.
She is thoughtful and considerate.

translations.translation: 考虑， 思考， 要考虑的事； 体贴， 关心

phrases.example: We took his age into consideration.
phrases.example_translation: 我们考虑到了他的年龄。

phrases.example: The proposal is under consideration.
Please show consideration for others.
After careful consideration, we decided to proceed.
phrases.example_translation: 经过仔细考虑，我们决定继续。

phrases.example: I submit this for your consideration.

translations.translation: 鉴于， 考虑到， 顾及

phrases.example: Considering that he is only 16, he did remarkably well.
phrases.example_translation: 鉴于他只有16岁，他表现得非常出色。

phrases.example: All things considered, it was a successful event.
phrases.example_translation: 综合考虑各方面，这是一次成功的活动。

phrases.example: Your proposal is still under consideration.
We must take into consideration the needs of elderly people.
phrases.example_translation: 我们必须将老年人的需求考虑在内。

phrases.example: The idea is definitely worth considering.
phrases.example_translation: 这个想法绝对值得考虑。

translations.translation: 由…组成； 在于； 一致

phrases.example: The team consists of five people.
Happiness consists in contentment.
The meal mainly consists of rice.
phrases.example_translation: 这顿饭主要由米饭构成。

phrases.example: The book consists largely of essays.
The cost consists entirely of fees.
phrases.example_translation: 费用完全由手续费组成。

translations.translation: 坚持的， 一贯的； 一致的， 符合的

phrases.example: His story is consistent with mine.
The team showed consistent performance.
The rules remain consistent.
Success needs consistent effort.
The brand has consistent quality.
He achieved conspicuous success.
His absence was conspicuous.
He avoided conspicuous consumption.
The red sign is highly conspicuous.
The product was in a conspicuous position.

translations.translation: 经常的，不断的，连续发生的；永恒的；忠实的，忠诚的

phrases.example: The constant noise annoyed him.
She gave constant support.
The world is in constant change.
The dog was his constant companion.
The temperature remained constant.
Fashions constantly change.
She constantly reminded him.
They constantly improve the product.
He constantly checks his phone.
The area is constantly under threat.
phrases.example_translation: 该地区始终处于威胁之中。

translations.translation: 组成， 形成； 设立； 任命

phrases.example: Pollution constitutes a serious threat to health.
phrases.example_translation: 污染对健康构成严重威胁。

phrases.example: The action constitutes a criminal offense.
Women constitute the majority of the workforce.
phrases.example_translation: 女性构成了劳动力的多数。

phrases.example: This does not constitute a problem.
The action constitutes a violation of the law.

translations.translation: 宪法， 章程； 组成； 设立

phrases.example: The constitution guarantees freedom of speech.
They voted to amend the constitution.
He has a weak constitution.
She has a strong constitution.
It is a constitutional right.

translations.translation: 建筑物； 构想， 观念

phrases.example: They constructed a new building.
She constructed a new theory.
Students learned to construct sentences.
He constructed a strong argument.
phrases.example_translation: 他构建了一个有力的论证。

phrases.example: The novel is well-constructed.

translations.translation: 建造； 建筑物； 结构

phrases.example: The bridge is under construction.
He works at a construction site.
The construction work finished.
The construction of the school took years.
He owns a construction company.
She gave constructive feedback.
He offered constructive criticism.
The constructive talks made progress.
phrases.example_translation: 建设性会谈取得了进展。

phrases.example: The UN played a constructive role.
phrases.example_translation: 联合国发挥了建设性作用。

phrases.example: Please give a constructive suggestion.

translations.translation: 请教； 查阅； 商议

phrases.example: He consulted a doctor.
She consulted with her lawyer.
We consulted an expert.
Consult the manual for help.
Consult your boss before acting.
phrases.example_translation: 行动前先征求老板意见。

phrases.example: She works for a top management consultancy firm.
phrases.example_translation: 她在一家顶级管理咨询公司工作。

phrases.example: He started his own IT consultancy last year.
phrases.example_translation: 他去年创办了自己的IT咨询公司。

phrases.example: The consultancy firm hired 50 new analysts this year.
phrases.example_translation: 这家咨询公司今年雇用了50名新分析师。

phrases.example: We offer professional consultancy services to businesses.
phrases.example_translation: 我们为企业提供专业的咨询服务。

phrases.example: She set up as an independent consultancy after leaving the big firm.
phrases.example_translation: 她离开大公司后成立了独立咨询机构。

translations.translation: 顾问； 会诊医师， 专科医生

phrases.example: They hired a consultant.
He is a consultant for the firm.
She works as a management consultant.
The consultant fee was high.
He is a senior consultant.

translations.translation: 消费， 吃完， 喝光； 毁灭； 使着迷， 充满

phrases.example: The machine consumes a lot of energy.
phrases.example_translation: 这台机器消耗大量能源。

phrases.example: People consume more food during holidays.
phrases.example_translation: 人们在假期消费更多食物。

phrases.example: The task consumed all her time.
phrases.example_translation: 这项任务花费了她所有时间。

phrases.example: He was consumed by anger.
The war consumed vast resources.

translations.translation: 消费者， 用户， 消耗者

phrases.example: The factory produces a wide range of consumer goods.

phrases.example_translation: 我们需要一个损坏零件的替代品。

phrases.example_translation: 这场革命受到自由和平等的共和理想的启发。

translations.translation: 名誉， 名气， 名声

phrases.example: The hotel has a good reputation.

phrases.example_translation: 建立好声誉需要多年时间。

phrases.example: She made a request for more information.
phrases.example_translation: 她提出了获取更多信息的请求。

phrases.example: The concert was held at the request of the president.
phrases.example_translation: 音乐会应总统的请求举行。

phrases.example_translation: 他们收到了许多求助请求。

phrases.example: Samples are available upon request.
Do you have any special requests?

translations.translation: 需要； 要求； 命令

phrases.example: This matter requires immediate attention.
The law requires companies to disclose risks.
phrases.example_translation: 法律要求公司披露风险。

phrases.example: All students are required to take the exam.
phrases.example_translation: 所有学生都被要求参加考试。

phrases.example_translation: 这份工作需要五年经验。

phrases.example: Protective gear is strictly required.
phrases.example_translation: 防护装备是严格要求的。

translations.translation: 要求； 必要条件； 需要， 需要的东西

phrases.example: She met the requirement.

She followed the legal requirement.

phrases.example_translation: 消防员从着火的大楼中营救了人们。

The rescue mission was a success.

translations.translation: 预订； 保留； 犹豫； 保留地

phrases.example_translation: 我想预订两个人的位子。

phrases.example_translation: 我毫无保留地推荐这本书。

phrases.example: You can check in at the reservation desk.

translations.translation: 储备； 保留； 拘谨， 矜持； 替补队员， 后备部队； 自然保护区

phrases.example_translation: 我们保留拒绝服务的权利。

phrases.example: The nature reserve protects rare species.
phrases.example_translation: 自然保护区保护稀有物种。

phrases.example: I'll reserve judgement until I see the evidence.
phrases.example_translation: 在看到证据之前我保留判断。

phrases.example_translation: 我们保留一些物资以备紧急情况。

phrases.example_translation: 知识的蓄水池是广阔的。

phrases.example: The city's water reservoir was built in the 1950s.
phrases.example_translation: 该市的水库建于20世纪50年代。

phrases.example: The professor is a reservoir of knowledge on ancient history.
phrases.example_translation: 这位教授是古代历史的知识宝库。

phrases.example: Engineers discovered a large oil reservoir beneath the seabed.
phrases.example_translation: 工程师们在海底发现了一个大型储油层。

phrases.example: The university is a reservoir of talent for the tech industry.
phrases.example_translation: 这所大学是科技行业的人才库。

phrases.example: Bats are considered a reservoir host for certain viruses.
phrases.example_translation: 蝙蝠被认为是某些病毒的宿主。

translations.translation: 住处， 住宅； 居住； 居住资格

phrases.example: She took up residence in the city.

phrases.example: He is a resident of New York City.

phrases.example_translation: 关键受访者提供了有助于解决调查的关键信息。

phrases.example_translation: 讨论限制在预算问题范围内。

phrases.example: The accident was the result of careless driving.
phrases.example_translation: 事故是粗心驾驶的结果。

phrases.example_translation: 社会主义与资本主义之间的争论持续至今。

phrases.example: The theory of socialism has evolved significantly over the past century.
phrases.example_translation: 社会主义理论在过去一个世纪里有了显著的发展。

phrases.example: China is the largest socialist country in the world.
phrases.example_translation: 中国是世界上最大的社会主义国家。

phrases.example: The socialist system emphasizes equality and public ownership.
phrases.example_translation: 社会主义制度强调平等和公有制。

phrases.example: The socialist party won a majority in the parliamentary election.
phrases.example_translation: 社会党在议会选举中赢得了多数席位。

phrases.example: Socialist values promote collective well-being over individual gain.
phrases.example_translation: 社会主义价值观提倡集体福祉高于个人利益。

phrases.usage: 表示「社会主义市场经济」
phrases.example: China has developed a unique socialist market economy.
phrases.example_translation: 中国发展了独特的社会主义市场经济。

phrases.example: She likes to socialize with her colleagues.
School helps socialize children.
phrases.example_translation: 学校帮助儿童实现社会化。

phrases.example: He enjoys socializing at parties.
Students are encouraged to socialize freely.
Children learn to socialize in groups.
phrases.example_translation: 儿童学会在群体中交际。

phrases.example: She decided to study sociology at the university.
phrases.example_translation: 她决定在大学学习社会学。

phrases.example: He works in the sociology department of a prestigious university.
phrases.example_translation: 他在一所著名大学的社会学系工作。

phrases.example: The sociology of education examines how social institutions affect learning.
phrases.example_translation: 教育社会学研究社会制度如何影响学习。

phrases.example: The sociology course covered topics like class, race, and gender.
phrases.example_translation: 社会学课程涵盖了阶级、种族和性别等话题。

phrases.example: Her sociology research focused on urban poverty and inequality.
phrases.example_translation: 她的社会学研究聚焦于城市贫困和不平等。

translations.translation: 碳酸钠， 纯碱； 汽水， 苏打水

phrases.example: Would you like some soda water with your whiskey?
phrases.example_translation: 你的威士忌要加些苏打水吗？

phrases.example: Add a teaspoon of baking soda to the recipe for fluffier cakes.
phrases.example_translation: 在食谱中加一茶匙小苏打可以让蛋糕更蓬松。

phrases.example: He crushed the empty soda can and threw it in the recycling bin.
phrases.example_translation: 他把空汽水罐压扁扔进了回收箱。

phrases.example: The kids asked for soda pop and chips at the party.
phrases.example_translation: 孩子们在聚会上要了汽水和薯片。

phrases.example: Soda ash is an important ingredient in glass manufacturing.
phrases.example_translation: 纯碱是玻璃制造中的重要原料。

phrases.example: She has a degree in software engineering from MIT.
phrases.example_translation: 她拥有麻省理工学院的软件工程学位。

phrases.example: Make sure to install the latest software update for security patches.
phrases.example_translation: 确保安装最新的软件更新以获得安全补丁。

phrases.example: The company is hiring experienced software developers.
phrases.example_translation: 公司正在招聘有经验的软件开发者。

phrases.example: Linux is one of the most popular open source software projects.
phrases.example_translation: Linux是最受欢迎的开源软件项目之一。

phrases.example: This software application can handle thousands of users simultaneously.
phrases.example_translation: 这个软件应用可以同时处理数千个用户。

phrases.example: The fertile soil in the valley is perfect for growing crops.
phrases.example_translation: 山谷里肥沃的土壤非常适合种植庄稼。

phrases.example: Deforestation has led to severe soil erosion in the region.
phrases.example_translation: 森林砍伐导致了该地区严重的水土流失。

phrases.example: Farmers test the soil quality before planting each season.
phrases.example_translation: 农民在每个种植季节之前测试土壤质量。

phrases.example: Chemical waste can pollute the soil and groundwater.
phrases.example_translation: 化学废物会污染土壤和地下水。

phrases.example: After years abroad, he longed to return to his native soil.
phrases.example_translation: 在国外多年后，他渴望回到故土。

translations.translation: 太阳的， 日光的； 太阳能的

phrases.example: Solar energy is a clean and renewable source of power.
phrases.example_translation: 太阳能是一种清洁可再生的能源。

phrases.example: They installed solar panels on the roof to reduce electricity bills.
phrases.example_translation: 他们在屋顶安装了太阳能电池板以减少电费。

phrases.example: Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system.
phrases.example_translation: 木星是我们太阳系中最大的行星。

phrases.example: More households are switching to solar power for heating.
phrases.example_translation: 越来越多的家庭转向使用太阳能供暖。

phrases.example: Thousands of people gathered to watch the solar eclipse.
The sole purpose of this meeting is to discuss the budget.
phrases.example_translation: 这次会议的唯一目的是讨论预算。

phrases.example: She was the sole survivor of the plane crash.
phrases.example_translation: 她是那次空难的唯一幸存者。

phrases.example: He took sole responsibility for the failed project.
phrases.example_translation: 他对失败的项目承担了全部责任。

phrases.example: As the sole provider for his family, he worked two jobs.
phrases.example_translation: 作为家庭的唯一供应者，他做了两份工作。

phrases.example: The manager has sole discretion over hiring decisions.
phrases.example_translation: 经理对招聘决定有全权决定权。

phrases.example: She is solely responsible for the project.
The decision was based solely on facts.
The room is used solely for meetings.
Success is not solely about money.
phrases.example_translation: 成功不仅仅是关于金钱。

phrases.example: The plan is solely dependent on funding.

translations.translation: 庄严的， 隆重的； 严肃的

phrases.example: He made a solemn promise to protect her for the rest of his life.
phrases.example_translation: 他庄严地发誓要用余生保护她。

phrases.example: The solemn ceremony was held to honor the fallen soldiers.
phrases.example_translation: 举行了庄严的仪式以纪念阵亡的士兵。

phrases.example: The judge wore a solemn expression as she delivered the verdict.
The funeral was a solemn occasion attended by hundreds.
phrases.example_translation: 葬礼是一个有数百人参加的庄重场合。

phrases.example: A solemn silence fell over the crowd during the memorial.
phrases.example_translation: 在纪念活动期间，人群中陷入了一片肃穆的沉默。

phrases.example: You should consult a solicitor before signing the contract.
phrases.example_translation: 签合同前你应该咨询律师。

phrases.example: The solicitor general presented the case to the court.
phrases.example_translation: 检察总长向法庭陈述了此案。

phrases.example: She instructed a solicitor to handle her divorce.
phrases.example_translation: 她委托律师处理她的离婚事宜。

phrases.example: He works at a solicitor's office in central London.
phrases.example_translation: 他在伦敦市中心的一家律师事务所工作。

phrases.example: They decided to hire a solicitor for the property dispute.
phrases.example_translation: 他们决定聘请律师处理房产纠纷。

phrases.example: The building has a solid foundation.
There is solid evidence of his guilt.
phrases.example_translation: 有确凿证据证明他有罪。

phrases.example: She has solid support from her team.
phrases.example_translation: 她得到团队的坚定支持。

phrases.example: The team delivered a solid performance.
He is solid and reliable.
This vitamin is soluble in water and needs to be taken daily.
phrases.example_translation: 这种维生素可溶于水，需要每天服用。

phrases.example: The compound is readily soluble in organic solvents.
phrases.example_translation: 这种化合物易溶于有机溶剂。

phrases.example: Vitamin D is a fat soluble vitamin stored in the liver.
phrases.example_translation: 维生素D是一种储存在肝脏中的脂溶性维生素。

phrases.example: Oats are rich in soluble fiber which helps lower cholesterol.
phrases.example_translation: 燕麦富含可溶性纤维，有助于降低胆固醇。

phrases.example: Every mathematical equation has a soluble problem behind it.
phrases.example_translation: 每个数学方程背后都有一个可解的问题。

translations.translation: 解决； 解决办法； 溶液

phrases.example: We need to find a solution to this problem.
phrases.example_translation: 我们需要找到这个问题的解决办法。

phrases.example: What is the best solution in this case?
phrases.example_translation: 在这种情况下最佳方案是什么？

phrases.usage: 表示「切实可行的解决方案」
phrases.example: We need a practical solution.
phrases.example_translation: 我们需要一个切实可行的解决方案。

phrases.example: Education is the solution to poverty.
phrases.example_translation: 教育是解决贫困的办法。

phrases.example: We need a long-term solution.
phrases.example_translation: 我们需要一个长期解决方案。

translations.translation: 解答； 解释； 解决

phrases.example: We need to solve this problem quickly.
phrases.example_translation: 我们需要迅速解决这个问题。

phrases.example: The detective solved the mystery.
She solved the puzzle in minutes.
He solved the equation correctly.
They tried to solve the conflict peacefully.
phrases.example_translation: 他们试图和平解决冲突。

phrases.example: Maybe somebody else can help you with this task.
phrases.example_translation: 也许别人可以帮你完成这个任务。

phrases.example: She wanted to find somebody special to share her life with.
phrases.example_translation: 她想找到一个特别的人共度一生。

phrases.example: He acted like he was somebody important at the party.
phrases.example_translation: 他在聚会上表现得像个重要人物。

phrases.example: Winning the award could make somebody's career.
phrases.example_translation: 赢得这个奖项可以让某人的事业腾飞。

phrases.example: In times of trouble, you need somebody to count on.
phrases.example_translation: 在困难时期，你需要一个可以依靠的人。

translations.translation: 由于某种原因， 不知怎么的； 以某种方式

phrases.example: We'll get there somehow or other, don't worry.
phrases.example_translation: 我们会以某种方式到达那里的，别担心。

phrases.example: Despite the difficulties, she somehow managed to finish on time.
phrases.example_translation: 尽管困难重重，她还是设法按时完成了。

phrases.example: I somehow feel that things will work out in the end.
phrases.example_translation: 我莫名觉得事情最终会好起来的。

phrases.example: He somehow found the right answer even without studying.
phrases.example_translation: 他不知怎的即使没学习也找到了正确答案。

phrases.example: The plant somehow survived the harsh winter without any care.
phrases.example_translation: 那株植物在无人照料的情况下勉强度过了严冬。

phrases.example: We should meet up sometime in the future.
phrases.example_translation: 我们将来某个时候应该见个面。

phrases.usage: 表示「不久前；某个时候以前」
phrases.example: I saw her sometime ago at the library.
phrases.example_translation: 我不久前在图书馆见过她。

phrases.example: I'll call you sometime next week to discuss the plan.
phrases.example_translation: 我下周某个时候打电话给你讨论计划。

phrases.example: Sometime later, he realized the truth.
phrases.example_translation: 过了些时候，他意识到了真相。

phrases.example: We plan to launch the product sometime this month.
phrases.example_translation: 我们计划这个月某个时候发布产品。

phrases.usage: 表示「有些不同；略有差异」
phrases.example: The results are somewhat different from what we expected.
phrases.example_translation: 结果与我们的预期有些不同。

phrases.example: I was somewhat surprised by the sudden change.
phrases.example_translation: 我对这突然的变化感到有些惊讶。

phrases.example: The exam was somewhat difficult for most students.
phrases.example_translation: 这次考试对大多数学生来说有些困难。

phrases.example: Parents are somewhat concerned about the new policy.
phrases.example_translation: 家长们对新政策有些担忧。

phrases.example: His health has somewhat improved since last month.
phrases.example_translation: 他的健康状况从上个月以来有所改善。

translations.translation: 老于世故的； 高级的； 精密的， 复杂的； 高雅的

phrases.example: The device uses sophisticated technology.
phrases.example_translation: 该设备使用了复杂的技术。

phrases.example: She has sophisticated taste in art.
phrases.example_translation: 她在艺术方面有精致的品味。

phrases.example: The security system is highly sophisticated.
A more sophisticated approach is needed.
The lab has sophisticated equipment.

translations.translation: 痛的；恼火的；急剧的，剧烈的

phrases.example: She had a sore throat and couldn't stop coughing.
He had sore muscles after running the marathon.
phrases.example_translation: 跑完马拉松后他肌肉酸痛。

phrases.example: His lack of education is a sore point that he doesn't like to discuss.
phrases.example_translation: 他缺乏教育是他不愿讨论的痛处。

phrases.example: Don't be a sore loser; accept the result gracefully.
phrases.example_translation: 别输不起；优雅地接受结果吧。

phrases.usage: 表示「刺眼的，惹人厌烦的」
phrases.example: That old car is a real sore eyes in the neighborhood.
phrases.example_translation: 那辆旧车在这个街区实在碍眼。

translations.translation: 悲痛， 悲哀， 悲伤； 伤心事， 不幸的事

phrases.example: She felt deep sorrow at the loss of her beloved pet.
phrases.example_translation: 她对失去心爱的宠物感到深深的悲痛。

phrases.example: The family was filled with sorrow and grief after the funeral.
phrases.example_translation: 葬礼后，全家人充满了悲痛与哀伤。

phrases.example: His failure was a great source of sorrow to his parents.
phrases.example_translation: 他的失败是他父母悲伤的根源。

phrases.example: After the breakup, he tried to drown his sorrow in alcohol.
phrases.example_translation: 分手后，他试图借酒浇愁。

phrases.example: The parting sorrow was written all over their faces.
phrases.example_translation: 离别之愁写满了他们的脸庞。

phrases.example: We need to sort out the problem before moving forward.
phrases.example_translation: 我们需要在继续之前解决问题。

phrases.example: I'm sort of tired today, so I might stay home.
phrases.example_translation: 我今天有点累，所以可能待在家里。

phrases.example: The market sells all sorts of fresh vegetables and fruits.
phrases.example_translation: 市场上卖各种各样的新鲜蔬菜和水果。

phrases.example: She spent the afternoon sorting through old photographs.
phrases.example_translation: 她花了整个下午整理旧照片。

phrases.example: We need the right sort of person for this challenging job.
phrases.example_translation: 我们需要合适的人来做这份有挑战性的工作。

phrases.example: The baby fell sound asleep after the long day of playing.
phrases.example_translation: 玩了一整天后，宝宝沉沉地睡着了。

phrases.example: The mentor gave sound advice that helped her make the right decision.
phrases.example_translation: 导师给出了明智的建议，帮助她做出了正确的决定。

phrases.example: The movie used amazing sound effects to create a realistic atmosphere.
phrases.example_translation: 这部电影使用了惊人的音效来营造逼真的氛围。

phrases.example: We were relieved to find the lost child safe and sound.
phrases.example_translation: 我们松了一口气，发现走失的孩子安然无恙。

phrases.example: They installed a new sound system in the concert hall.
phrases.example_translation: 他们在音乐厅安装了新的音响系统。

translations.translation: 酸的；馊的，酸味的；脾气坏的
变酸， 变馊； 变得乖戾

phrases.example: Don't drink the milk; it has gone sour.
phrases.example_translation: 别喝那牛奶，它已经变酸了。

phrases.example: The lemon has a distinctly sour taste.
His comments about the prize were just sour grapes.
phrases.example_translation: 他关于奖项的评论不过是酸葡萄心理。

phrases.example: Their relationship went sour after the argument.
phrases.example_translation: 争吵之后他们的关系恶化了。

phrases.example: Add a dollop of sour cream on top of the baked potato.
phrases.example_translation: 在烤土豆上加一勺酸奶油。

translations.translation: 河的源头， 根源； 来源， 出处

phrases.example: The internet is a major source of information.
phrases.example_translation: 互联网是主要的信息来源。

phrases.example: Tourism is the main source of income for the island.
phrases.example_translation: 旅游业是该岛的主要收入来源。

phrases.example: Solar power is a renewable source of energy.
phrases.example_translation: 太阳能是一种可再生的能源来源。

phrases.example: Nature is a great source of inspiration.
phrases.example_translation: 大自然是伟大的灵感来源。

phrases.example: The software is open source and free to use.
phrases.example_translation: 该软件是开源的，可以免费使用。

phrases.example: Farmers sow seeds in the spring for a summer harvest.
phrases.example_translation: 农民在春天播种以获得夏天的收成。

phrases.example: The teacher sowed the seeds of curiosity in her students.
phrases.example_translation: 老师在她学生心中播下了好奇的种子。

phrases.example: The rumor was spread to sow discord among the team members.
phrases.example_translation: 散布谣言是为了在团队成员之间挑拨离间。

phrases.example: The farmer decided to sow oats in the lower field.
phrases.example_translation: 农夫决定在下方的田里种燕麦。

phrases.usage: 表示「种什么因得什么果」
phrases.example: If you work hard now, you will reap what you sow later.
phrases.example_translation: 如果你现在努力工作，以后就会得到回报。

phrases.example: NASA plans to launch a spacecraft to Mars next year.
phrases.example_translation: NASA计划明年发射一艘航天器前往火星。

phrases.example: The unmanned spacecraft successfully landed on the asteroid.
phrases.example_translation: 无人航天器成功着陆在小行星上。

phrases.example: The spacecraft mission lasted for over two years.
phrases.example_translation: 这次航天任务持续了两年多。

phrases.example: China has successfully developed crewed spacecraft for its space program.
phrases.example_translation: 中国已成功为其太空计划开发了载人航天器。

phrases.example: The spacecraft docking with the space station was completed smoothly.
phrases.example_translation: 航天器与空间站的对接顺利完成。

phrases.example: I appreciate people who call a spade a spade and don't beat around the bush.
phrases.example_translation: 我欣赏直言不讳、不拐弯抹角的人。

phrases.example: He used a spade to dig a hole for the new tree.
phrases.example_translation: 他用铲子为新树挖了一个坑。

phrases.example: She bought a new garden spade at the hardware store.
phrases.example_translation: 她在五金店买了一把新的园艺铲。

phrases.example: The researchers did the spade work before the main experiment.
phrases.example_translation: 研究人员在正式实验前做了基础工作。

phrases.phrase: black as the ace of spades
phrases.example: The night was as dark as the ace of spades.

translations.translation: 持续， 贯穿； 包括； 横跨， 跨越

phrases.example: The average life span of a domestic cat is about fifteen years.
phrases.example_translation: 家猫的平均寿命约为十五年。

phrases.example: The project was completed in a short span of time.
phrases.example_translation: 该项目在很短的时间内完成了。

phrases.example: Children have a shorter attention span than adults.
phrases.example_translation: 儿童的注意力持续时间比成人短。

phrases.example: The bridge has the longest span of any suspension bridge in the world.
phrases.example_translation: 这座桥拥有世界上所有悬索桥中最长的跨度。

phrases.example: The new highway will span across three provinces.
phrases.example_translation: 新高速公路将横跨三个省份。

phrases.example: What do you do in your spare time?
We will spare no effort to achieve the goal.
phrases.example_translation: 我们将不遗余力地实现目标。

phrases.example: We keep spare parts in the warehouse.
phrases.example_translation: 我们在仓库里存放备件。

phrases.example: Can you spare a few minutes?
Spare the rod and spoil the child.
phrases.example_translation: 省了棍棒就会惯坏孩子。

phrases.example: The rescue team's arrival gave a spark of hope to the trapped miners.
phrases.example_translation: 救援队的到来给被困矿工带来了一线希望。

phrases.example: The controversial comment sparked off a heated debate online.
phrases.example_translation: 那条有争议的评论在网上引发了一场激烈的辩论。

phrases.example: The mechanic replaced the spark plugs to fix the engine.
phrases.example_translation: 机械师更换了火花塞来修好引擎。

phrases.example: The organizer asked participants to keep only items that spark joy.
phrases.example_translation: 组织者请参与者只保留能激发快乐的物品。

phrases.example: The chemical was added to spark a reaction in the solution.
phrases.example_translation: 加入化学物质以引发溶液中的反应。

phrases.example: She was referred to a medical specialist for further examination.
phrases.example_translation: 她被转诊给医学专家做进一步检查。

phrases.example: The company hired an IT specialist to upgrade their network.
phrases.example_translation: 公司聘请了一位IT专家来升级他们的网络。

phrases.example: He is a specialist in tropical diseases with years of experience.
phrases.example_translation: 他是热带疾病方面的专家，有多年的经验。
